trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied RichText XML string may declare and have libxml substitute (LIBXML_NOENT) external/nested entities; decided solely in DOMDocumentFactory::loadXMLString, which parses untrusted input with entity substitution on.

landing_point.why: The only loadXML call in src/ that passes LIBXML_NOENT; a grep for loadXML/LIBXML_NOENT from the XXE summary lands here immediately.

fix_sites.entry_point: PHP API Type::acceptValue/fromHash (content create/update incl. REST) via InputHandler::fromString; Symfony form RichTextTransformer transform/reverseTransform; RichTextValidator constraint
same as above (post-parse CDATA-to-text conversion on returned document)
new internal helper XMLSanitizer, only called from DOMDocumentFactory

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Other DOMDocument::loadXML calls (Value ctor, REST postProcessValueHash, SearchField, RichTextStorage) omit LIBXML_NOENT, so a solver can correctly argue they do not substitute external entities; there is no plausible-but-wrong dismissal to exploit.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Editor input in the xhtml5-edit namespace is normalized by prepending a DTD of HTML named character entities (  etc.) which must still be substituted; dropping LIBXML_NOENT or rejecting every DOCTYPE breaks this, and the fix explicitly keeps simple internal entities.

O6_input_shapes: SYSTEM/PUBLIC external entity declarations in internal DTD subset (fix.diff:139-142)
nested/recursive internal entities referencing other entities, billion-laughs (fix.diff:152-155, fix.diff:174-185)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Value constructor parsing a string with LIBXML_NOENT, reachable from Type::fromPersistenceValue and directly via public `new Value($xml)` in the PHP API
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer wanting named entities ( ) to survive a save/reload could plausibly add the same flags as DOMDocumentFactory; it is a save/reload route the report would not name.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: REST outgoing processor re-parsing stored XML with entity substitution before XSLT conversion
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The xhtml5edit conversion of documents with character entities would motivate copying the factory's options; lives in a separate REST package.

O9_family: XXE / XML external entity injection (CWE-611), with entity-expansion hardening

O10_build.toolchain: PHP ^7.3||^8.0 with ext-dom, ext-xsl, ext-libxml; composer; phpunit ^9.5
O10_build.project_tests: tests/lib/eZ/RichText/DOMDocumentFactoryTest.php (unit, no DB); integration tests need ezplatform-kernel legacy setup

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop LIBXML_NOENT (or reject any DOCTYPE) in loadXMLString, which breaks the named-character-entity DTD the normalizer injects for editor input.

out_of_scope_notes: The published XMLSanitizer is regex-based (DOCTYPE/ENTITY line parsing, tag stripping) and also removes script/iframe/style tags; its completeness against parser differentials was not assessed.
XmlBase::loadFile (src/lib/eZ/RichText/XmlBase.php:49) and XSLT stylesheet loading only read package-shipped trusted files.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); the source tree is a small library and may fall under tiny_repo (<5 MB).
Assumes libxml2 >= 2.9 default (no external entity loading without LIBXML_NOENT) for dismissing the other loadXML sites; runtime libxml version not checked.
